title: Rafael and the Letter
author: Jude Halloran
blurb: Rafael Montrose, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
